environment: macOS / Codex in-app browser, Vite development fixture, one sample
interactionChecks: Preview does not select a session or change the current draft; explicit continue restores the target draft
Synthetic branch creation adds exactly one child; fit reveals 4 session nodes instead of 3
Existing background run marker remains visible
Fold/unfold, locate current, zoom and keyboard pan retain metadata-only graph reads
Workspace file text paging works; opening file panel switches graph layout using actual remaining width
320px Enter-to-preview and return preserve the original composer; no horizontal overflow
limitations: Synthetic API fixture and transport: no real user sessions, model calls or WebSocket connections
Timing is first node DOM availability, not browser paint/LCP; development sample is not a performance threshold
Heap includes fixture turn metadata and UI caches, and is not a retained-memory delta
Initial and preview readings come from separate runs of the same fixture
Windows, Linux desktop, Safari/WebKit and physical phone input were not tested
